statement: A running model, not a calibrated one, and thinner than the wisteria model it is derived from: there was no prototype of this plant to carry numbers over from, so most are copied from wisteria or are placeholders. None has been measured on a plant. Use its output to compare scenarios and to show what a design implies, not to predict dates, sizes or loads.

phenology.budburstDoy.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

phenology.floralInitiationDoy.basis: Flowers on the year’s own growth (itself an inference for this species), so buds are taken to form on that growth about a fortnight before flowering. No dated source.

phenology.flowerOpenDoy.basis: Flowers open in succession across the RHS flowering envelope of mid to late summer (9 July to 23 August).

phenology.petalFallDoy.basis: Placed inside the RHS flowering envelope of June to August (1 to 31 August).

phenology.flowerLastsDays.basis: How long one flower cluster lasts. A placeholder.

extension.leaderMPerSeason.basis: RHS: reaches its 8 to 12 m size band in 5 to 10 years, but is slow in cool sites. A size band is not a growth rate; a placeholder.

extension.lateralMPerSeasonByOrder.basis: Scaled down from the leader rate as in the wisteria model. Not measured.

extension.whipMPerSeason.basis: Every year the old stems throw new side shoots, which is where an established plant makes its leaves and flowers once the framework has stopped extending. Rate is a placeholder.

extension.establishmentFactorByYear.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

architecture.trunkStemStartYears.basis: Two stems from the base, both from the first season. A placeholder.

architecture.leaderLengthM.basis: The RHS ultimate-size band used as a cap on stem length. A height band is not a route length, so this is a placeholder.

architecture.lateralLengthMByOrder.basis: Scaled down from the leader as in the wisteria model. Not measured.

attachment.maxGraspDiameterMm.basis: No measurement exists. Taken as well below the timber lattice (76 mm round) and above a cable, so that this plant twines cables unaided and has to be tied to glulam. The whole difference between it and wisteria on the structure rests on this number.

organs.leafSpacingM.basis: Leaves in opposite pairs on short internodes. Not measured.

organs.leavesPerNode.basis: Honeysuckles bear their leaves in opposite pairs. A character of the family, not sourced here.

organs.spurChance.basis: Stands for the short leafy side shoots that keep old stems clothed. A placeholder.

organs.spurLengthM.basis: Short leafy side shoots. A placeholder.

organs.racemeLengthM.basis: Size of a flower cluster. A placeholder.

organs.whipShareOfNodes.basis: Every year the old stems throw new side shoots, which is where an established plant makes its leaves and flowers once the framework has stopped extending. The share of nodes that do so is a placeholder.

organs.whipsPerYearMax.basis: A cap on new side shoots a year. A placeholder.

organs.whipLengthM.basis: Length of a year’s side shoot. A placeholder.

organs.leafLifespanYears.basis: Evergreen. Leaves are taken to last three seasons; cold wind may strip them sooner.

organs.clearStemHeightM.basis: Clothed nearly to the ground. A placeholder.

flowering.competenceYears.basis: Taken to flower from its second season. A placeholder.

flowering.maturityRamp.basis: Half strength in its first flowering year. A placeholder.

flowering.spurFloralChance.basis: Not applicable to this plant; present because every model carries every parameter.

flowering.currentSeasonFlowersPerM.basis: Flower clusters per metre of the year’s growth. A placeholder chosen to read as present but not profuse.

flowering.currentSeasonMinShootM.basis: A shoot shorter than this is taken not to flower. A placeholder.
